subject: Request: temporary runway padding for Medicore pilot (procurement in progress)
messages:
From: Claire Zhou <claire.z@medicore.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement is taking longer than expected

Hi Neha,

Quick note from the Medicore side — legal and procurement are still reviewing the PO and we likely won't have an executed order until the end of next week. The engineering team is mid-integration and we're concerned about losing momentum if the sandbox access lapses.

Would Redwood be open to a short-term runway extension (or provisional credits) to keep the pilot live while procurement finishes? We expect the PO to clear by 8/20. If helpful I can attach the PO draft.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Zhou | Sr. Product Manager
Medicore Health
Attachment: Medicore_PO_Draft.pdf (pdf, 198 KB)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Claire Zhou <claire.z@medicore.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement is taking longer than expected

Hi Claire — thanks for the update and for sending the PO draft (received).

Short answer: yes, we can usually accommodate a short runway extension while procurement is in-flight. I want to confirm a couple quick details before I request formal approval:
- Target clearance date you expect (you mentioned 8/20)
- Is the team currently consuming against a trial credit bucket? If so, roughly how many tokens / hours are left in the sandbox this week?

I'll loop in Sean from CS to make sure the environment stays stable, and I'll ask Marissa for temporary-credit approval given the size of the anticipated usage. Once I have their OK I'll send formal confirmation and a short terms note (credits expire on the PO execution).

If you prefer a quick call, I'm free 2–4pm PT today.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot access — procurement is taking longer than expected

Looping in my notes and decision for the record — thanks for flagging.

Summary from CS: Medicore is actively integrating and has run several end-to-end tests; there's clear momentum and a committed timeline. They estimate the PO to be signed by 2026-08-20.

Approval: grant a temporary credit pool of $3,000 (applies to sandbox usage only) and extend sandbox access through 2026-08-26. Conditions:
- Credits expire if a signed PO (or invoice payment) is not received by 2026-08-26.
- We reserve the right to reduce throughput if abuse or unexpected high-cost usage is observed.

Neha — please send the customer a one-paragraph confirmation with the credit amount, expiration, and the HubSpot deal link. Sean — please standby to apply the credits once the customer acknowledges. I'll attach an internal approval stub.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: internal_approval_RDW4521.pdf (stub)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Claire Zhou <claire.z@medicore.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming short-term runway padding for Medicore pilot

Hi Claire — thanks again for the PO draft and the timeline. Per the internal approval below, Redwood will provision a $3,000 temporary credit pool for your sandbox and extend your evaluation window through 2026-08-26 to give procurement runway.

Key points:
- Credit amount: $3,000 credit applied to your sandbox (one-time grant).
- Expiry: credits and extended access will expire on 2026-08-26 if a signed PO or cleared payment is not received.
- Usage: credits are for sandbox/test usage only and cannot be applied retroactively to prior consumption.
- Next steps: please confirm receipt of this note. Once you confirm, Sean will apply the credits and share the updated usage dashboard.

HubSpot deal reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4521
Attachment: temporary_credit_grant.pdf (pdf, 24 KB)
